How It Works

About Holiday Explorers (HX)

Since 1989, we've been part of South Australia. For over 35 years, we've helped adults with intellectual disability access holidays, travel, and social experiences.

In 2026, we're taking a new direction. We're moving from being a direct service provider to a community facilitator. This means:

  • Lower costs – We work with free or low-cost community programs.
  • More connection – We focus on group experiences and friendship.
  • Greater sustainability – Our term-based model ensures each program is viable.
  • Wider reach – We partner with existing community events and organisations.

Our mission remains unchanged: To build social inclusion, independence, and wellbeing for people with disability and older Australians.
